title: Organzza wins Drag Race Brasil Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (BR-S01-E12), the final four — Betina Polaroid, Hellena Malditta, Miranda Lebrão, and Organzza — lip-synced to Anitta's "Envolver". Organzza was crowned the winner of Drag Race Brasil's first season; Betina Polaroid, Hellena Malditta, and Miranda Lebrão all finished as runners-up.

title: Diva More: Brazil's first Porkchop
summary: Diva More was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Brasil (BR-S01-E02), losing "Bandida" by Pabllo Vittar ft. Pocah to Betina Polaroid after a split premiere with no elimination in episode 1.
